text: Lindqvist Dairy has recalled its soft cheese after routine testing found possible listeria contamination, the company said in a notice filed with the National Food Safety Authority on Tuesday. The recall covers 180-gram tubs sold nationwide under the “Meadow Cream” label between 14 and 22 October, with lot codes LC2410 and LC2411. The authority said no illnesses had been reported as of Wednesday evening, but advised consumers to discard the product or return it for a refund. In a statement signed by quality director Anja Berg, Lindqvist said the issue was traced to a packaging line at its North Vale plant and that production had been suspended pending inspection.
